QuestInfo.name: Olive Makes a Request
QuestInfo.2:
While exploring Victoria Island, you bumped into a shiny-seeking girl named Olive on the trail of a jewel held by the Thieves Guild.

Olive sent you to a secret Thieves Guild room to scout, but you stumbled into a fight!

You managed to defeat the intruder. Olive complained that all the shiny stuff she likes gets stolen by others first.

You and Olive concluded it must be a secret organization powerful enough to infiltrate the Thieves Guild...
